## Change

Describe the behavior or deliverable and link the owning issue.

## Verification

List commands/checks actually run and results. For unrun checks, state what is
still missing. Include relevant simulation/reference, Quartus, and SC2/board
evidence; do not imply one proves another.

## Interfaces and limits

Identify changed packet/module/scenario assumptions, third-party reuse, and
remaining limitations. Update setup instructions and planning documents when needed.
